pet_notes: Friendly chibi whale-maid girl based on the user reference. Long layered deep-blue hair with cyan tips, bright blue eyes, two whale-fin ears, one large dark-blue whale tail, white frilled maid headband, navy bow at the collar, dark navy and white maid dress with a white apron, tiny navy shoes. Preserve an unmistakable whale-maid silhouette. No text or readable logo.
style_notes: Codex digital pet style: compact super-deformed chibi, oversized head and tiny body, pixel-art-adjacent stepped edges, thick dark navy 1-2 px outline, limited navy blue cyan white palette, flat cel shading, simplified dress and hair masses, no gradients, no shadows, no detached effects.
house_style: Codex digital pet sprite style: pixel-art-adjacent low-resolution mascot sprite, compact chibi proportions, chunky whole-body silhouette, thick dark 1-2 px outline, visible stepped/pixel edges, limited palette, flat cel shading with at most one small highlight and one shadow step, simple readable face, tiny limbs, and no detail that disappears at 192x208. Avoid polished illustration, painterly rendering, anime key art, 3D render, vector app-icon polish, glossy lighting, soft gradients, realistic fur or material texture, anti-aliased high-detail edges, and complex tiny accessories.
